newsitem.title: USA: AMERCO says to retain Oxford unit.
newsitem.headline: AMERCO says to retain Oxford unit.

text.p: AMERCO said Tuesday that after an evaluation of alternatives, it has decided to retain its life insurance subsidiary, Oxford Life Insurance Co.

The company said in a statement that it plans to have management continue to implement a business plan, consisting of direct sales, joint ventures, acquisitions and other transactions, to increase Oxford's return on equity "now and into the future."
In August, AMERCO had said it was exploring alternatives, including strategic alliances or a possible sale, regarding the Oxford unit.
